subject: general
question: Which of the following is named as Asia's largest slum?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dharavi**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dharavi**:-

 
 
• Dharavi is a residential area in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.
 
• **It has often been considered to be one of the world's largest slums. **
 
• Dharavi has an area of just over 2.39 square kilometres (0.92 sq mi; 590 acres) and a population of about 1,000,000.
 
• **Dharavi is a densely populated area with a high mix of residential and commercial activities. **
 
• It is home to a wide range of industries, including leather tanning, pottery, recycling, and food processing.
 
• Dharavi is also a major center for trade and commerce.
 
• **It is home to a diverse population of people from all over India and the world. Dharavi is also a cultural hub, with a variety of temples, mosques, churches, and other religious institutions.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** Orangi town:-**

 
 
• Orangi Town is a municipality in Karachi, Pakistan.
 
• **It is located in the northwestern part of the city.**
 
 
 
• **Khayelitsha:-**
 
 
• **It is a township in the Western Cape province of South Africa, about 30 kilometers east of Cape Town. **
 
• It is the second-largest township in the country, after Soweto in Johannesburg.
 
• The name "Khayelitsha" is Xhosa for "new home."
 
 
 
• **Niza:-**
 
 
• **It is a city on the French Riviera, in southeastern France. **
 
• It is the capital of the Alpes-Maritimes department.
 
• Niza is a popular tourist destination, known for its Mediterranean climate, beautiful beaches, and vibrant nightlife.
